description.zh:
查询任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
> 查询任务结束时间需晚于查询任务开始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页最大记录数，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询任务开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

descriptions.zh:
使用该接口需满足以下前提条件：

- 使用阿里云或DAS的SDK时，建议使用最新版本。
- 在调用DAS服务时，需要将地域指定为cn-shanghai。
- 本接口适用的数据库引擎为：

    - RDS MySQL
    - PolarDB MySQL版
    - Redis
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, take note of the following items:

- If you use an Alibaba Cloud SDK or a Database Autonomy Service (DAS) SDK to call this operation, we recommend that you use the latest version of the SDK.

- If you use an SDK to call operations of DAS, you must set the region ID to cn-shanghai.

- This operation is applicable to the following database engines:

  - ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL

  - PolarDB for MySQL

  - ApsaraDB for Redis
